content.overview: A mature handoff communicates what is complete, what remains open and who owns the next action. Metrics should reveal process performance without hiding denominator, scope or data-quality limits.

vocabulary.definition: Ability to reconstruct controlled work, evidence, decisions and changes from retained records.
Defined population or opportunity count used to interpret a rate.
Measure intended to show control activity or emerging risk before a final outcome.

sections.title: The packet tells a reconstructable story
sections.body: Lot genealogy, process records, results, deviations, dispositions, CAPA and approvals should be linked rather than scattered.

sections.title: Metrics retain definitions and denominators
sections.body: Deviation rate, hold time, traceability completion or repeat-event measures require stable scope and data-quality notes.

sections.title: Open work transfers explicitly
sections.body: Handoff identifies unresolved risks, due dates, owners and interim controls using written plus verbal communication where warranted.

workedExamples: A falling deviation count is interpreted cautiously after production volume and reporting completeness changed; denominator and data quality remain visible.
commonMistakes: Closing a handoff with open CAPA omitted.
Collecting metrics with no decision or owner.
content.practicalApplication: Assemble a QA handoff index and metric dictionary for a postharvest lot, including open items and review cadence.
content.summary: Audit-ready handoff joins reconstructable records with honestly defined metrics and accountable next actions.
